'''''Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures''''' is an ongoing [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series in the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia initiative. The series was written by [[Daniel José Older]], and the [[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 1|first issue]] was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[December 6]], [[2023]].
